items.title: Football: Lobos howl louder
items.summary:
Just when you think Head Coach Jason Eck and his squad can't impress any more, they do.

For the first time in program history, the New Mexico Lobos have won a game in Reno, Nev. The then No. 22-ranked Lobos went on the road and made it look easy out there against the Wolf Pack on Friday night, delivering a 31-3 beatdown.

items.title: FOOTBALL: Recent offensive struggles reopen possibility of multiple quarterbacks this week against Nevada
items.summary:
Things could look a little different on offense for New Mexico this week.

UNM's passing game struggles have been the main topic during media availability with Head Coach Jason Eck and quarterback Toa Fa'avae lately. The Lobos' 148 passing yards per game, which ranks eighth-fewest in the FBS, hasn't sunk the ship, largely thanks to its defense, run game and coaching.
